items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: There was a guy that had a recording studio in Chicago. He had excellent equipment, named Bill Putnam. Remember him?

ctx.x: Later the 5100 Club, because this is where we were more or less discovered by the recording studio.
